notes_for_editor: One source only: a single list row for 'taylor' (Long County, 31.943529, -81.753868, 86 ft, note 'aerial imagery'). Its name is a bare lowercase word like other list entries (pineland, statenville), so it may be a locality rather than the tower's own name; a human should check against Georgia Forestry Commission records before publishing. No proposed name correction is made because no source gives one. Two web searches found no Taylor or Long County lookout tower record. A Fire Tower Rd SE in Ludowici appears only in real-estate listings and was not read; it is an unconfirmed lead. The list's GFC-provided-coordinates note covers the BLL-numbered rows and may not apply to this row. Confidence low.
